name: R097-alakazam-trick-both-itemless
why: Challenge 7. The player's Alakazam (596, Choice Band; Trick, Disable, Psychic, Skill Swap) leads against Armaldo (513: Knock Off, Quick Claw). When Armaldo Knocks Off the Band (a quarter of the AI's picks per turn) Alakazam is itemless; after Armaldo falls, Weezing (501, Sitrus Berry) comes in, Psychic brings it under half HP so the Sitrus Berry is eaten, and a Trick then finds neither Pokemon holding an item (battleScriptTryswapitemsOpcode failureControl). Needs Weezing to survive the hit and the AI's Knock Off on one of the first turns.
